messages:
lina_docs: opened a small PR to fix a mismatch in the Rate Limits page: the quota table listed "starter" as 250k tokens but the pricing grid shows 200k. Also included a tiny SDK header migration snippet and two dashboard link fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4444 :eyes:
omar_devex: thanks. can you paste the SDK curl snippet and the corrected quota row so I can sanity check?
ria_eng: FYI infra recently normalized quota label keys (tier -> quota_tier). docs should use `quota_tier` in examples and call out the old key as legacy for 30 days.
lina_docs: pasted snippets inline. kept them compact and explicit.

SDK header migration (curl + JS):
```bash
# legacy header
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Quota: 200000" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/quotas

# recommended new header
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Usage-Limit: 200000" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/quotas
```

```js
// helper to translate legacy header to new header
function upgradeHeaders(headers) {
  if (headers['X-Redwood-Quota']) {
    headers['X-Redwood-Usage-Limit'] = headers['X-Redwood-Quota'];
    delete headers['X-Redwood-Quota'];
  }
  return headers;
}
```

Corrected quota table row (prose):
- Starter: allocation_tokens = 200000 per month (previously listed as 250000 in site copy; source of truth is pricing grid v3.1)

lina_docs: I also added a short "how to keep dashboards working" note: use a recording rule or a Grafana transform to map `quota_tier` from old label `tier` during the overlap window. Example recording rule in Prometheus added.
omar_devex: tiny nit: can we explicitly warn customers not to hardcode the legacy header in automation? also add a one-liner about the header being case-insensitive on the server but copy as-cased for readability.
lina_docs: updated PR: added sentence: "Do not hardcode legacy headers in long-lived automation; request a temporary compat alias from support if needed." also added note about header casing.

ria_eng: confirm on infra thread that label normalization (tier -> quota_tier) will be emitted for ~21-30 days. I'm leaving a comment on the PR to verify exact overlap.
ci-bot: docs build succeeded for PR 4444 (lint: 0 warnings, 1 suggestion).
omar_devex: editorial nit: change the phrase "fix a mismatch" to "correct a discrepancy with the pricing grid" so it reads less like an error report. Also suggest adding a changelog line under "Docs" for transparency.
lina_docs: changed wording, added changelog bullet. added metadata tags: `rate-limits`, `quotas`, `migration-guides`. merging after infra confirms overlap window and ops schedules redirect. :shipit: 
doc-bot: TOC updated; added `migration-guides` tag.
